associations.rationale: forwardRep constructs a quiver representation from a path-algebra module, but does not state the claimed equivalence.
isoClassEquiv directly gives an equivalence between path-algebra module isomorphism classes and opposite-quiver representation isomorphism classes.
moduleRoundTrip is a round-trip linear equivalence used to support the module-to-representation correspondence.
repRoundTrip is a round-trip equivalence for a constructed representation rather than the correspondence statement itself.
reverseModule constructs the module associated with a representation, serving as a component of the equivalence.
